description: Dynatrace classic problem-notification Slack integration (incoming webhook) with the default '{State} Problem {ProblemID}: {ImpactedEntity}' message and the problem title linked to {ProblemURL}.
provenance: Dynatrace docs: classic Slack integration (Settings > Integration > Problem notifications > Slack; Message accepts problem placeholders) and Notifications API models ({State} OPEN/RESOLVED/MERGED, {ProblemID} display number, {PID} problem id, {ProblemTitle}, {ProblemURL}, {ImpactedEntity}, {ProblemImpact} APPLICATION/SERVICE/INFRASTRUCTURE, {ProblemSeverity}). The attachment layout (title linked to the problem, Impact/Severity fields) is reconstructed; classic problem URLs are <env>/#problems/problemdetails;pid=<PID>.
